summary: NIFTY 50 at Depth: the INDEX_FULL packet carries OHLC, the change and the trade time at byte 35, and no book, OI or 52-week range.

notes: No live index packet was recorded.

deviations.reason: The desktop puts its mode label (ltp, quote, full) in data.mode; the Paytm web adapter puts the subscription mode number there (1, 2, 3). Follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.

The desktop sends the change under the canonical names price_change and price_change_percent beside the Paytm (change_absolute, change_percent) web names; price_change is not a docs key and the web adapter sends none, so it goes. Names follow each broker's own web adapter, mode by mode (lead ruling 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.

The web sends zero; the docs say leave it out (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md, "Field availability": a field the stream does not carry is not invented as zero; lead decision 2026-11-09). Paytm's INDEX_FULL packet carries no trades, average price or book totals; the web sends 0 for each (message.get(..., 0)), the desktop's index frame leaves them out.

The web's index-full parser stores the trade time as last_trade_time and its normaliser reads last_traded_time, so the web sends ltt 0 and loses the time; the desktop decodes it (audit: web defect fixed on desktop).

An index has no open interest and the INDEX_FULL packet carries none; the web sends no oi, the desktop sends 0 (a Depth tick's OI is always rendered). A desktop defect: mark OI absent for index packets.
